decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests results at least near aspiration, and in a growing, R&D-active medium-sized firm this close-to-core service is likely worth retaining.

Although it remained only generally mentioned on the website and so may be performing less clearly above aspiration than other launches, it is a close-to-core framework product line that the firm can likely carry given its broad portfolio and some organizational slack.
The product gained clearer positioning and a dedicated page by 2024, indicating satisfactory early reception, and its strong fit with enterprise GIS integration makes it unlikely to be cut soon.
As a 2024 workshop closely building on the firm’s established consulting business, it is still in an early evaluation phase and is inexpensive to keep while the firm learns about demand.
